items.title: Write the review assurance floor execution plan
items.context: Create a durable decision document explaining mandatory review floors: docs-only typo/annotation stays one round, ordinary code changes require at least one review round, failures or bugs escalate to 3x1, and high-risk gate/Authority/process-fact work requires 3x2 or explicit degraded-single-host evidence.
items.userSees: User sees a new execution plan under docs/requirements/decisions/ that names the mandatory review floor and escalation policy.

items.title: Audit the document with three single-host rounds
items.context: Because this is a process-fact/gate policy document, run three local single-host audit rounds against the written plan and record whether each round found real correctness issues or passed without Authority overclaim.
items.userSees: User sees three local single-host audit results recorded as Non-authority evidence before closure.
